snippet.title: Eras of Alchemy™
snippet.description:
A wave of asteroids has decimated Earth's species. Can you help H.E.R.A. repopulate the planet?

Download on the App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/eras-of-alchemy/id712554968

Get in on Google Play™: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.sheado.evolution

Available at the Amazon Appstore For Android: http://www.amazon.com/gp/mas/dl/android?p=net.sheado.evolution

For the NOOK Family of Devices by Barnes & Noble:
http://www.barnesandnoble.com/w/eras-of-alchemy-sheadonet/1118890673

Download from Windows Phone Store:
http://www.windowsphone.com/en-us/store/app/eras-of-alchemy/896e0db6-31df-4b9e-835b-8ca307df3eda
